# Best MagSafe/Qi2 car mounts

The review sites I checked don't agree on a single winner, so I've picked by use case. I only have the review pages and one store link from my search, not direct product pages. For most picks, use the "Buy on Amazon" buttons on the linked articles.

**Best for most iPhone owners: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
- Three of the guides pick it as best overall. It includes a 1 m USB-C cable and a 27W car adapter, and rotates between portrait and landscape.
- Check your vents first. Belkin's specs call for slats no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep, and horizontal slats work best. Vertical slats can shift under the phone's weight.
- Sources: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Best for fast charging and reliability: Anker Prime MagGo AirCool (A2933), $89.99**
- It does Qi2 25W with thermoelectric cooling plus a fan. Mount Guys uses it daily and calls it their best overall. The Gadgeteer lists a 60W adapter in the box and shows it at $69.99 on sale, so check the current price.
- Limits: Anker excludes Tesla and Mercedes-Benz vehicles, cars without vent blades, and the iPhone 16e. Only the iPhone 16 Pro Max/16 Plus and newer reach 25W. Older iPhones get about 15W.
- Sources: [Mount Guys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/), [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Best value with cooling: ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost**
- A built-in fan helps prevent heat throttling, and it mounts on a vent or dashboard. ESR's official store listing shows a WPC Qi2 certification.
- Prices conflict. The Gadgeteer lists $18.99, while Dealectric shows $39.99 at ESR's store, or $32.80 with code PARTNER18 (tested Oct 22, expires Dec 31, 2026). Dealectric doesn't say whether a car adapter is included, so you may need to buy one.
- [Buy at ESR's official US store](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.

**Best budget 25W: LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan, from $39.95**
- It ships with a 95W adapter, and the fan must stay on to reach 25W (fan off caps it at 15W). The suction base is large.
- Source: [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Best if you don't want charging: VICSEED Steel Core Vent Mount**
- It has a metal-core vent clip with no power cable. Mount Guys chose it based on research and didn't test it hands-on.
- Source: [Mount Guys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/)

## Buying tips
- Look for an actual **Qi2 badge**. "MagSafe-compatible" alone may mean only 7.5W.
- Check the **power adapter**. 25W models need a 45W or stronger USB-C car charger, and the 15W LISEN needs at least 18W per port.
- Ignore "80 lb suction" or "gf" magnet claims on cheap listings. They often describe the suction cup, not the phone hold.

If you tell me your phone and whether you prefer vent or dash mounting, I can narrow this to one pick.
